desc: The rod has 5 charges. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHeal000000]{Heal} (expends 1 charge) or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplResurrecti]{Resurrection} (expends 5 charges).
The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the rod disappears in a harmless burst of radiance.
name: rod of resurrection
